leads.title: The Chinese government donated humanitarian aid for victims of the earthquake and tsunami in Central Sulawesi, Indonesia
leads.place: Balikpapan, Indonesia
leads.description: On October 9th, 2018, the Chinese humanitarian aid in response to the earthquake and tsunami in Central Sulawesi Indonesia landed in Balikpapan. The supplies donated included tents, water purifiers, fogging equipment, generators, and other disaster relief assistance.  At 6:02pm on September 8th, 2019, an earthquake of 7.4 magnitude hit the Central Sulawesi area and later caused a tsunami that continued the damaged in the area. According to the Indonesia National Disaster Relief Agency, as of October 9, the natural disaster has caused 2,010 deaths, 82,775 people forced to relocated, 67,310 houses destroyed, and 2,736 schools have been destroyed as well. Chinese President Xi sent his condolences to Indonesia President Widodo, and expressed that China is with the Indonesian people and help Indonesia through the rebuilding process.

leads.title: Confucius Institute at the University of Liberia and the Chinese Embassy in Liberia provide funding for the Liberia-China Wushu School and Gymnasium
leads.place: The project constructed the Liberia-China Wushu School in Monrovia, the capital of Liberia, behind the SKD sports complex. More detailed locational information can be found at https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/141278508#map=18/6.26010/-10.70062
leads.description: On January 6th, 2018, the Liberia-China Wushu School and Gymnasium officially opened. The school was funded by the Chinese Embassy in Monrovia, the Confucius Institute at the University of Liberia, and the Liberia National Wushu Association. Dignitaries from the Ministry of Youth and Sports, Ministry of State and Ministry of Foreign Affairs, the Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces of Liberia, the Police Inspector General and Foreign Service Director all attended the turning over ceremony. According to the president of the Liberia National Wushu Association, Fred J. A. Pratt, the project was constructed with help from the government and people of China through its embassy in Monrovia in partnership with the LNWA.  Currently, Master Russian Martial Arts & Fitness Academy, a Wushu school for young Liberians, operates in the gymnasium. The school has enrolled more than thirty students. The project includes a school, gym, offices, bathroom, and many other facilities. The school is located behind the SKD sports complex in Monrovia.   At the same time, the China-Liberia Wushu Exchange Event was successfully held at the SKD Stadium Zhongli Wushu School. The Liberia National Martial Arts Ass

leads.title: Majority Chinese-owned Malian New Sugar Federation aids in UN assault vehicle accident in Mali
leads.place: The purpose of this project was to aids in UN assault vehicle accident near Malian New Sugar Federation. The approximate locations for the Malian New Sugar Federation (Chinese name: 马里新糖联) are: https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/1703669524https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/694212047
leads.description: On July 13, 2013, the Malian New Sugar Federation (Chinese name: 马里新糖联), whose majority owner is Sinolight, sent two cranes and personnel to aid in rescuing soldiers involved in a crash of a UN armored t vehicle.  The 14 ton vehicle rolled over, killing one solider and injuring eight. The accident occurred near the sugar mines, and with the help of Sinolight, they were able to rescue soldiers and remove the damaged vehicle from the scene. The Malian New Sugar Federation is subsidiary controlled by China Light International Holdings Corporation

leads.title: Chinese Government implements Phase 11 of agricultural technical assistance in Micronesia (Linked to #64030, Umbrella Project #64557)
leads.place: The Pohnpei pilot farm is located in Madolenihmw Municipality, Pohnpei State. Additionally, the China-Micronesia Friendship Demonstration Farm is located at the College of Micronesia. More detailed locational information can be found at https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/3823802 and https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/316806679.
leads.description: In early 2018, the Chinese Government began implementing Phase 11 of agricultural technical assistance to Micronesia. It is unsure when the agreement was signed. The mission's main goal is to support the Pohnpei pilot farm (or FSM-China Friendship Demonstration Farm) in Micronesia. Umbrella Project ID #64557 captures all 11 phases of technical cooperation.  The start and end dates are difficult to pin down. AidData assumes phase 10 (#64026) ended sometime in 2018, but the exact date is unknown. A Chinese Embassy article from March 2019 uses language suggesting the phase 11 experts had just arrived in Micronesia and were about to begin work. Moreover, a 2019 speech from the Chinese Ambassador to FSM says that 2019 was "the first year" of phase 11 and that they hoped to complete Phase 11 in 2021.   The farm is located in the state of Pohnpei spanning 80,000 square meters including 40,000 square meters of tropical rain forests. The farm cultivates crops like sakau, yam, taro, banana, and others. The remaining 40,000 square meters houses laboratories, offices, and greenhouses. The purpose of this bilateral cooperation is to train local Micronesian farmers, introduce new seeds, and tran
leads.staff_comments: The Chinese title for this project is 援密第十一期佩州示范农场技术合作项目.

leads.title: Chinese Government donates 100 mobile board houses for resettlement activities in Rakhine State in 2018 (linked to project #64429)
leads.place: This project involves the donation of mobile homes for resettlement efforts in Rakhine State, Myanmar. More detailed locational information can be found at https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/5996483.
leads.description: On January 6, 2018, the handover ceremony of 100 sets of mobile board houses donated from the Chinese Government was held at the Myanmar Industrial Wharf in Yangon. The assembled-board house can accommodate 8 people and can be used for at least 20 years. These board houses will be used to house displaced people in Rakhine State. The Chinese side will also provide personnel technical support, guide the Myanmar side to install and debug the prefabricated houses, and conduct centralized technical training for the Myanmar side technical personnel. The monetary value of these houses is unknown.  Later in October 2018, the Chinese Government donated 1,000 mobile houses to Myanmar (recorded in the linked project #64429).

leads.title: Chinese Embassy donates supplies to Naypyidaw village in Myanmar in 2018
leads.place: The purpose of this project was to donate supplies to Naypyidaw village in MyanmarAdditional locational information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/315390382
leads.description: On October 23, 2018, during the celebration of the traditional Thadingyut Festival in Myanmar, Chinese Ambassador Hong Liang visited the site of the China-Myanmar Poverty Alleviation Project in a village in Naypyidaw. The Ambassador extended his festive greetings to the villagers and delivered a speech. During the visit, the Ambassador also donated rice, oil, and school supplies to the locals. The monetary value of the donation is unknown.  China-Myanmar Poverty Alleviation Project aims to help Myanmar establish demonstration sites for poverty reduction. It was officially launched in February 2018.

leads.title: Peiyang Chemical Corp. commits 70% financing for Edo Modular Refinery
leads.place: The project constructed the Ologbo modular refinery in Ologbo in Ikpoba Okha Local Government Area. More detailed locational information can be found at https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/501422142
leads.description: On January 10, 2018, the Edo State Government signed a memorandum of understanding with a consortium of Chinese companies for the construction of a modular refinery in Edo State. The consortium consisted of Peiyang Chemical Equipment Company of China (PCC), Sinopec International Petroleum Service Corporation (SIPS) (subsidiary of Sinopec, a state owned enterprise) and African Infrastructure Partners (AIP), a Nigerian company. The MOU signing occured at SINOPEC headquarters in Beijing, China, and was witnessed by officials of the Nigerian Embassy, as well as the Governor of Edo State, Godwin Obaseki.   At an unkown point a joint venture between PCC and AIP, known as AIPCC Energy Limited took ownership of the project.  The PCC agreed to finance up to 70% of the refinery's building costs. According to the Orient Energy Review, the Edo State Government also committed financing with a N700 million loan. The project was to have two construction phases; phase 1 consisting of 500bpd demonstration refinery and phase 2 consisting of a 5,000bpd capacity refinery. According to the Energy Mix Report, the refinery was completed in August 2020 at a cost of $10.2 million. According to the AIPCC fu
leads.staff_comments: Unsure if foreign direct investment or joint venture - at some point a joint venture came into possession of the project but unknown when

leads.title: CDB signed an Memorandum of Understanding that will help implement the New Clark City Project (Linked to Project ID#64749, #63610, #63593)
leads.place: The project aims to construct New Clark City, a metropolis financed by the Chinese Government in the Pampanga provincence. More locational data can be found at https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/675364504. The project intends to build an industrial park to the direct west of the New Clark City Economic Zone. It is located in the Municipality of Capas, near New Clark Town. More locational data can be found at https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/919056923#map=15/15.3549/120.5192.
leads.description: On November 26th, 2017, the Philippines and Chinese governments signed a memorandum of understanding for the Clark Industrial Park Project (or the "New Clark City Industrial Park Project"). In the MoU, China committed to developing the industrial park and bring in Chinese investors. On November 19th 2018, China Energy Construction Co. Ltd. and the Philippines representative signed an agreement for the Clark Industrial Park Project. The China Gezhouba Group Company Limited (CGGC) has also signed an MoU for the project with the also partnered to develop the Bases Conversion and Development Authority (BCDA). On January 7, 2018, a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) was signed between the Bases Conversion and Development Authority (BCDA) and China Development Bank (CDB) for a framework agreement for financing cooperation. The agreement would allocate money for projects under the "Build Build Build" initiative, specifically "high impact infrastructure projects," such as the New Clark City Project.   New Clark City aims to be the country's first smart, green and disaster-resilient metropolis. For this project, China sought to build one or multiple "industrial parks" across the Philippines
leads.staff_comments: 1. This project is linked to umbrella project ID#64749, the financing cooperation with the CDB that would fund this project, and subsidiary infrastructure projects also potentially funded by the agreement; project ID#63610, the Subic City Railway project, and project ID#63593, BGC-NAIA-Makati Bus Rapid Transit project.

leads.title: Chinese Government funds Phase 2 of Agricultural and Animal Husbandry Technical Assistance Project (linked to project ID#55550)
leads.place: No location info available.
leads.description: On February 22, 2018, the ambassador to Sao Tome and Principe and the Minister of Agriculture and Rural Development of Sao Tome and Principe signed the agreement for Phase 2 of Agricultural and Animal Husbandry Technical Assistance Project. The monetary value of this project is unknown. On July 16, 2018, a group of high-level officials from STP participated in an agricultural and animal husbandry training course in Beijing, marking the start of this project. Phase I of this project is recorded in the linked project #55550.  This phase is slated to last two years and will include Chinese technical assistance to teach agriculture and fishing. The Chinese Embassy in STP indicates that Phase I was more small-scale and experimental while Phase II will see the project be implemented more widely. The technical assistance project was expected to end in August 2020. While most of the team left Sao Tome and Principe at this time, animal husbandry expert Wei Wangfei stayed behind with a Portuguese translator and one other agricultural expert, forming a "stay behind" group of the agricultural technical assistance group.   On August 10, 2020, at the invitation of the Shengpu Pig Breeding Develo
leads.staff_comments: The Chinese project title is 署援圣普第二期农牧业技术援助项目. In Portuguese, the project title is Fase 2 do Projeto Chinês de Assistência Técnica Agropecuária.

leads.title: China MOFCOM holds mariculture training in Timor-Leste
leads.description: In 2018, China sent nine specialists and technicians to Timor-Leste to provide mariculture training to 20 local trainees. The training was organized by China’s Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM). The Permanent Secretariat of Forum Macau also coordinated sending specialists from the corresponding sectors in Portugal to participate in the training. The training was part of the coastal marine culture project launched by Yuan Long Ping High-Tech Agriculture Co. Ltd. in 2016, which is set in an area of five hectares and is a general base for training technicians, and for demonstration and reproduction of marine products such as fish and shrimp. The training helped to create a base of qualified staff for the development of fisheries in Timor-Leste.

leads.title: China Sends Short-Term Medical Expert Team to Trinidad and Tobago (Subproject of #69439)
leads.place: This project involves technical assistance to Eric Williams Medical Sciences Complex and San Fernando General Hospital in Trinidad and Tobago. More detailed locational information can be found at https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/356632123 and https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/745222014.
leads.description: On May 14th, 2018, Prime Minister Kieth Rowley signed multiple Memorandums of Understanding with the Government of the People's Republic of China. Among these was an agreement on Strengthening Cooperation in the Field of Medicine and Health. One of the provisions of this agreement was to provide multiple short-term medical expert teams to Trinidad and Tobago for periods of one month each. _x000D_ _x000D_ The team administered by Tiantan Hospital, consisted of 9 members mainly from neurosurgery and anesthesiology departments, arrived on 3 September, 2018. They reviewed difficult cases with the Trinidadian Regional Health Authorities, carried out demonstration of surgeries and free clinic visits, and donated medical equipments and medicines. The team is designated to work for one month._x000D_ _x000D_ A donation ceremony was held between the two parties on 17 September, 2018.
leads.staff_comments: Trinidad and Tobago is not ODA-eligible after 2011.

leads.title: Chinese Government provides $500,000 grant in May 2018 for resettlement efforts following Ambae Volcano eruption
leads.place: Ambae, Vanuatu
leads.description: On May 17, 2018, the Chinese Government donated USD 500,000 to the Vanuatu Government to assist in the country's response to the Ambae volcanic disaster. The donation is specifically intended to aid Vanuatu with the Ambae Resettlement efforts.   Ambae Volcano erupted in October 2017 and and March 2018.

leads.title: China donates a batch of rice to poor families in Hadhramaut of Yemen in 2018
leads.place: Hadhramaut, Yemen
leads.description: On November 21, 2018, China handed over a donation of rice to the government of Hadhramaut in Yemen.The Chinese embassy reported that the rice benefits 3,500 displaced people, poor families and orphans, including 2,100 in Wadi Hadramout and 1,400 in the coastal areas.

leads.title: China sends second round of relief aid for Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh (Linked to #54502)
leads.place: A second Chinese cargo plane carrying relief supplies for Rohingya refugees arrived in Bangladesh's southeastern Chittagong region. More detailed locational information can be found at https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/3824588.
leads.description: On 28 September 2017, a Chinese cargo plane carrying a second humanitarian aid donation from the Chinese government arrived in Chittagong, Bangladesh for displaced Rohingya refugees displaced from Myanmar. The donation included 2,000 tents and 3,000 blankets, but the financial value of this aid is unknown. The United Nations Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) Financial Tracking Service captures this donation in flow ID #165008. _x000D_ _x000D_ The first round of donations from the Chinese government is captured in project #54502.

leads.title: China sends first round of relief aid for Rohingya refugees in Bangladesh (Linked to #54501)
leads.place: A second Chinese cargo plane carrying relief supplies for the Rohingya refugees arrived in Bangladesh's southeastern Chittagong region. More detailed locational information can be found at https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/3824588.
leads.description: On 27 September 2017, a Chinese cargo plane carrying 57 tons of aid materials donated by the Chinese government arrived in Chittagong, Bangladesh to assist Rohingya refugees displaced from Myanmar. The value of the donation is unknown. The next day, another Chinese cargo plane with a second aid package (#54501) flew to Bangladesh.

leads.title: [Cancelled] CDB provides loan to Paper Excellence for its acquisition of Eldorado pulp and paper mill in Brazil
leads.place: This project supported the partial ownership of Eldorado Brasil Celulose SA (Eldorado). More detailed locational information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/187815851#map=14/-20.6002/-51.6075
leads.description: On September 2, 2017, Paper Excellence B.V. (PEBV) — a special purpose vehicle that was legally incorporated in the Netherlands in 2008 and that is wholly owned by Jackson Wijaya Limantara, the grandson of Sinar Mas founder Eka Tjipta Widjaja — and its wholly-owned subsidiary CA Investment (Brazil) SA signed a share purchase agreement with J&F Investimentos. The purpose of the agreement was to enable PEBV to purchase a 100% equity stake in Eldorado Brasil Celulose SA (Eldorado) — a Brazilian pulp and paper producer — from J&F Investimentos for BRL 15 billion. China Development Bank (CDB) provided a loan to PEBV to facilitate the acquisition. On September 25, 2017, PEBV successfully acquired a 13% ownership stake in Eldorado from J&F Investimentos.   Several months later, in December 2017, PEBV increased its stake in Eldorado to 49.41%. According to the terms of the share purchase agreement, PEBV had one year (until September 2, 2018) to raise the necessary bank financing to buy the remaining 50.59% equity stake in Eldorado. leads.title: China Ministry of Agriculture and Bulgarian Ministry of Agriculture jointly launched Agricultural Demonstration Zone
leads.place: The purpose of this project was for the China Ministry of Agriculture and Bulgarian Ministry of Agriculture to jointly launch the Agricultural Demonstration ZoneMore detailed locational information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/7284256#map=17/42.13460/24.76724
leads.description: On 23 May 2017, the China Ministry of Agriculture and Bulgaria Ministry of Agriculture signed a joint statement to launch the first agricultural demonstration zone between China and the Central and Eastern European countries. The original memorandum of understanding was signed between China and Bulgaria in 2017. The agricultural demonstration zone was launched at the Agricultural University of Plovdiv. The cooperation will focus on agricultural scientific research, development of agricultural machinery, planting, breeding, and improving the supply chain. The "16 + 1" framework is the basis for the cooperation agreement. China and Bulgaria will support the construction of the demonstration zone in terms of policies, manpower, materials, and funds. The demonstration zone is a result of talks between Prime Minister Boyko Borissov and Chinese counterpart Li Keqiang, which took place in Sofia in 2016. On 24 November 2017 construction of the agricultural demonstration zone had been completed. The maintenance of the building will be funded by the Bulgarian Ministry of Agriculture and through donations.

leads.title: Chinese Government provides humanitarian assistance to respond to cholera outbreak
leads.description: In September 2017, the China’s Ministry of Commerce granted humanitarian assistance to the Government of Democratic Republic of Congo to aid with a cholera outbreak. The outbreak has spread to 18 provinces across the country with over 500 killed and 24,000 infected. The value of the donation and its exact handover date are unknown.

leads.title: China delivers a batch of agricultural material to Dominica [linked to Project #56148]
leads.description: On January 17, 2017 a batch of Agricultural material was presented to Dominica as a part of the Agricultural Technical Cooperation Project with China. The materials included seedling propagation materials, agricultural facility accessories, agricultural machinery parts, etc. The project will continue to assist farmers with high quality seedlings, technology demonstration and extension services.
leads.staff_comments: The project is linked to Project #56148 as part of an umbrella project.

leads.title: Chinese government finances demonstration base for paddy rice cultivation at Werer Agricultural Research Center
leads.place: The purpose of this project is to establish a rice experiment in the Werer Agricultural Research Center Northeast Ethiopia's Afar region, located 278 kilometers away from the capital, Addis Ababa. More detailed locational information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/1707249
leads.description: In February 2017, a base for rice experiments and demonstration was established in the Werer Agricultural Research Center in Northeast Ethiopia's Afar region, which is affiliated with Ethiopia Institute of Agricultural Research and is 278 kilometers away from the capital, Addis Ababa. The project was funded by the Chinese government, but the amount of financing is unclear._x000D_ _x000D_ The construction of the base was led by Luo Xueyi, who along with another Chinese agricultural expert, arrived in Ethiopia in May 2016 to find irrigation solutions in water shortage areas. Working with local agricultural experts, they wrote a proposal to the Ministry of Agriculture of Ethiopia, suggesting the establishment of a demonstration project on productive paddy rice cultivation in Werer. One month later, the proposal was authorized and Werer was designated as an experimental demonstration base for paddy rice cultivation.

leads.title: Xuzhou Construction Machinery Group (XCMG) provides 41 water cellars for Ethiopian Village
leads.place: The project provided water cellars to the village of Golebo Quilto in the Adami Tullu and Jido Kombolcha district within Oromia Regional State in Ethiopia. Golebo Quilto is located near the town of Adamitulu, which is located within the Adami Tullu and Jido Kombolcha district. More detailed locational information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/220915430
leads.description: Xuzhou Construction Machinery Group provided a 4.43 million RMB joint donation with 26 strategic suppliers to build 80 water cellars in Ethiopia, 40 for families and 40 in schools. Each school will be equipped with a 10,000-litre carbon fiber water tank, VZN water filter, five drinking fountains and five washbasins, which will provide 1,000 students with water for drinking, cooking and personal hygiene for 2 to 3 days. The date of when this agreement was signed is currently unknown.  On November 2nd, 2018, Xuzhou Construction Machinery Group inaugurated 41 water set to benefit over 600 households in the village of Goleba Qulito, in the Oromia region of southern Ethiopia.. Before the water cellars, many Ethiopians in this area had to get water either from contaminated rivers or from the area's groundwater which contained too much fluoride. The purpose of this project was to provide clean drinking water to villagers and schools in the area.

leads.title: Chinese Government provides grant for Phase 2 of Juncao Mushroom Technical Cooperation Project (Linked to Project ID#49135)
leads.place: This project supported demonstration farm at the Legalega Research Station on the outskirts of the city of Nadi. More detailed locational information can be found at https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/7148202085
leads.description: In December 2017, the Juncao Mushroom Technical Cooperation Project entered into its second phase. Through this phase, experts provided technical demonstration, training, and promotion to farmers in Fiji. More than 900 Fijian farmers will attend the training courses. This phase was also funded by the Chinese Government, though the grant commitment (transaction) amount unknown. The project was meant to kickstart mushroom production in Fiji and supply feed to livestock husbandry in the dry season. It was expected to assist Fiji in developing the Juncao industry and raise Fijian farmers' income.   As of the end of 2018, more than 1,000 farmers and technicians had been trained and more than 20,000 substrate tubes and 200,000 roots of Juncao grass had been distributed to Fijian farmers. The project also created a production line for mushrooms at the demonstration arm – from seedlings to packaging and storage – with an annual production capacity of 300 tons of fresh mushrooms.
leads.staff_comments: This project is also known as the Second Phase of the Juncao Technological Demonstration Program or Second Phase of the Juncao Mushroom Technology Demonstration Center Project. The Chinese project title is 中国援助斐济菌草技术合作项目. The first phase of the project, funded by an RMB 8.2 million grant from the Chinese Government, involved the construction of a demonstration farm at Legalega Research Station, trainings, and the provision of materials (See Project ID#49135)

leads.title: China conducts Phase IV of Juncao Project in Lesotho (Linked to #21745, #55680, #55681)
leads.description: According to a press release from Fujian Agricultural and Forestry University (FAFU), in November 2017, four FAFU alumni arrived in Lesotho to be the 4th Chinese team conducting the Juncao Technical Demonstration Cooperation Project (援莱索托菌草技术合作项目第四期). The Chinese Embassy hosted a reception on 8 February 2018 to formally welcome the experts and launch phase IV. As of January 2019, the fourth phase was ongoing. China also carried out phase I (#21745), phase II (#55680), and phase III (#55281). The other phases were in two-year intervals, so phase IV likely ended in late 2019 or early 2020. The value of this project is unknown._x000D_ _x000D_ "Jun" (菌) means fungus and "cao" (草) means grass. Juncao, invented in 1986 by a Chinese scientist, refers to the practice of using herb plants to cultivate edible fungi. Since the project's initial signing in October 2006, Chinese experts from FAFU have been developing the Zhonglai Juncao Technology Demonstration Base in Maseru and training local Basotho the agricultural techniques to grow and the entrepreneurial skills to sell.
