leads.title: Chinese Government Scholarships fund 116 students to study in China
leads.description: On August 25, 2017, the Chinese Embassy hosted a sendoff ceremony for 116 Malawian students that were the 2017/18 recipients of the Chinese Government Scholarship.  Ambassador Wang and Malawi Education Minister Msaka delivered speeches, and a number of senior officials from the Ministry of Education and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs attended. The scholarship covers a registration fee, tuition fee, fee for laboratory experiment, fee for internship, fee for basic learning materials and accommodation on campus. It also includes a living allowance, resettlement subsidy, and transportation. The total value of the scholarships is unknown.  Since the establishment of diplomatic ties, China has provided approximately 600 government scholarships to Malawi.

leads.title: Chinese Government dispatches 40 experts to provide technical support at Animal Husbandry Technology Demonstration Center in Mauritania (linked to Project ID#32588)
leads.description: Since April 2017, a three-year technical cooperation partnership with Animal Husbandry Technology Demonstration Center (funded and built by Chinese parties, described in #32588) began. Until May 2019, 40 agricultural experts have been sent to the center from Xingxia. The cooperation will take about three years. _x000D_ _x000D_ This project is linked to project #32588, construction of the Animal Husbandry Technology Demonstration Center by Ningxia Agriculture and Animal Husbandry Department.
leads.staff_comments: The project should be completed in April 2020, but it is unsure whether it is completed or not.

leads.title: Chinese Government funds Agriculture and Animal Husbandry and Biogas Demonstration Project (linked to #73443 and #68381)
leads.description: On January 7, 2018, the ignition ceremony was held for the Agriculture and Animal Husbandry and Biogas Demonstration Project. A team was dispatched by the Chinese Government to provide technical assistance in the agriculture and animal husbandry areas. The project seems to still be ongoing, and it is unclear where funding for the project comes from, but it is likely that it is sourced from the initial 5-year cooperation agreement signed in 2017 (#68381).    On February 22, 2018, Chinese Ambassador Wang Wei and the Sao Tome Minister of Agriculture and Rural Development agreed to extend the project into Phase II. This phase is slated to last two years and will include Chinese technical assistance to teach agriculture and fishing. One source  indicates that Phase I was more small-scale and experimental while Phase 2 will see the project be implemented more widely. On April 12, 2018, an ignition ceremony was held with biogas developed by the technical assistance project (showcasing it can be used for cooking fuel) and the team of experts arrived in Sao Tome and Principe to begin the two-year aid mission. On July 16, 2018, a few personnel from the Agriculture and Animal Husbandry Techni
leads.staff_comments: The Portuguese project title is Biogás do Projecto Agrícola. The Chinese project title is 援圣普农牧业技术援助项目.

leads.title: Chinese Navy provides humanitarian medical services to Sierra Leone
leads.place: The purpose of the project is to provide humanitarian medical services to Sierra Leone. More detailed location information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/27565056#map=11/8.4790/-13.2680
leads.description: On September 19, 2017, per Xinhua News, the Chinese naval hospital ship 866 (known as "Peace Ark") arrived at Freetown Port, Sierra Leone tasked with a mission to deliver free medical services. A welcoming ceremony was held on the ship. The goal of this mission was to enhance the cooperation between the two countries._x000D_ _x000D_ During the visit, the staff carried out free medical services for both Sierra Leonean and Chinese people. In total, they received 8,177 patients, and performed  CT, DR, B-ultrasound, electrocardiogram checks for 3,909 people. 34 people were hospitalized, and 51 had operations. The hospital ship sent a medical teams to the Joint HQ of health of the Sierra Leonean armed forces, Sierra Leone-China Friendship Hospital, resettlement sites for the mudslide victims, and homes for the disabled to carry out health and disease prevention and education, medical visits, environmental killings, cultural associations, etc._x000D_ _x000D_ On September 26, 2017, the ship left Sierra Leone.

leads.title: Chinese Government provides grant for establishment of agricultural technology promotion and demonstration center
leads.place: The center is located at Buramata hill in Gihanga commune within Bubanza Province. More detailed locational information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/3356146562
leads.description: On July 28, 2016, during the Forum on China-Africa Cooperation Beijing, the Chinese Government agreed to an agricultural modernization project in Burundi. Then, in 2018, the Chinese Government provided a grant for the establishment of an agricultural technology promotion and demonstration center in Burundi.   Construction started on June 1, 2018, and was scheduled to last for 2 years. A mid-term inspection of the project was conducted on June 1, 2019. STECOL Corporation, a Power Construction Corporation of China (POWERCHINA) is the main contractor responsible for project implementation.   The center is located at Buramata hill in Gihanga commune within Bubanza Province. It is spread over an area of ​​3,420 square meters and it houses demonstration sites for rice and corn, a seed processing workshop, a livestock food processing workshop, a storage shed, a repair shed for agricultural machinery, a barn, dormitories, and an office.
leads.staff_comments: The French project title is le projet du centre pilote agricole. The Chinese project title is 到援布隆迪农业示范中心项目 or 布隆迪农业示范中心项目.

leads.title: Chinese Government provides grant for Solar Street Lighting Project
leads.place: Bangui
leads.description: On July 7, 2016, the Chinese Government officially completed and handed over the the Solar Street Lighting Project to the local authorities in the Central African Republic. The solar energy demonstration project involved the provision and installation of 200 solar street lights to provide night illumination for some public facilities and roads in Bangui. It was implemented by ZTE Corporation and was completed and put into use in June 2017. According to Chinese Ambassador Ma Fulin, this was the first project to be restarted in the Central African Republic after the country's civil war. It is unclear when the project exactly began and how much it cost to implement.
leads.staff_comments: This project is also known as the China-Africa Solar Demonstration Project. The Chinese project title is 中国援中非太阳能示范项目.

leads.title: Chinese Government provides grant — through Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Fund — for China-Laos Poverty Reduction Cooperation Community Demonstration Project (Linked to Project ID#49339)
leads.place: The purpose of the project was to undertake a set of community development activities — including agro-business demonstration, improvements of small-scale public infrastructure and environment, and capacity building activities —  in Thadokkham village within Xaythany District and Vientiane Municipality.  More detailed locational information can be found at https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/4684991781
leads.description: On November 13, 2014, the Lancang-Mekong Cooperation (LMC) mechanism was established at the 17th China-ASEAN Summit. On March 23, 2016, the Chinese Government established the Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Fund, through which China pledged to provide $300 million over 5 years to 5 countries along the Mekong River -- Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand, and Vietnam -- to fund small and medium sized cooperation projects (as captured via Project ID#49339). The Chinese Government subsequently provided grant funding through the Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Fund for the China-Laos Poverty Reduction Cooperation Community Demonstration Project. The purpose of the project was to undertake a set of community development activities — including agro-business demonstration, improvements of small-scale public infrastructure and environment, and capacity building activities — in Thadokkham village within Xaythany District and Vientiane Municipality. Guangxi Foreign Capital Poverty Reduction Project Management Center and International Poverty Reduction Center in China (IPRCC) cooperated with the Department of Rural Development and Cooperatives of the Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry of Laos to impleme

leads.title: Chinese government provides scholarships for 60 students to study in China
leads.description: On August 28, 2016, a farewell ceremony was held for 60 Malawian students going to study in China on scholarship from the Chinese government. The scholarship covers a registration fee, tuition fee, fee for laboratory experiment, fee for internship, fee for basic learning materials and accommodation on campus. It also includes a living allowance, resettlement subsidy, and transportation. The value of these scholarships is unknown.

leads.title: China holds Biogas Technology Training
leads.place: Ouad Naga, Trarza
leads.description: On November 13, 2016, an opening ceremony was held for the Overseas Training Course on Biogas Utilization Technology for Mauritania. According to Biogas, the training is sponsored by the Ministry of Commerce of People’s Republic of China and organized by the Biogas Institute of the Ministry of Agriculture. The training was held at the Demonstration Center of Livestock and Pasturing, in Ouad Naga in the Trarza region. The course was 56 days long, beginning on October 10th and finishing on December 4th, 2016. It had 30 participants and covered "development of biogas technology in China, the introduction of agriculture in China, and design and construction of household digester"._x000D_ _x000D_ According to the Ministry of Finance, a commencement ceremony was held on November 30th, 2016 at the Mauritania Animal Husbandry Technology Demonstration Center. The training lasted 56 days; however, the start date is unknown.

leads.title: China provides a grant for China-Nepal Agricultural Technical Cooperation Project Phase I
leads.place: The high-yield demonstration field is located at the NARC in Lalitpur. More detailed locational information can be found at https://www.google.com/maps/place/National+Agriculture+Research+Center/@27.6552058,85.3264603,15z/data=!4m2!3m1!1s0x0:0x4e8ac00a800a05b3?sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjhhMHlk4fpAhU3j3IEHUC4Bf4Q_BIwCnoECBAQCg and https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/222337801#map=18/27.65516/85.32677
leads.description: In February 2016, the Chinese and the Nepali governments signed an agreement to grant for the China-Nepal Agricultural Technical Cooperation Project Phase I, which was to last for three years. Yuan Longping High-tech Agriculture Co. Ltd. was identified as the Chinese contractor responsible for implementing station of the project in cooperation with Nepal’s National Agricultural Research Council (NARC). Through this project, Longping High-tech Agriculture Co. Ltd. and NARC conducted various comparative trials and high-yield demonstrations of Chinese hybrid rice. Two varieties LPNBR 1628 and LPNBR 1632 were planted in around 10 ropanies of land. _x000D_ _x000D_ On July 2018, China launched an extensive training course on "Hybrid Maize Comprehensive Technologies" which lasted for 46 days under this project.
leads.staff_comments: CITIC Group -- a Chinese state-owned enterprise -- is the largest shareholder of Yuan Longping High-tech Agriculture Co. Ltd. The project's exact locational coordinates are available at https://www.google.com/maps/place/National+Agriculture+Research+Center/@27.6552058,85.3264603,15z/data=!4m2!3m1!1s0x0:0x4e8ac00a800a05b3sa=X&ved=2ahUKEwjhhMHlk4fpAhU3j3IEHUC4Bf4Q_BIwCnoECBAQCg

leads.title: Chinese Government commits RMB 8.2 million grant for various projects (Linked to Project ID#52629, #52630, #52632)
leads.description: It is reported that on July 4, 2016, the People's Republic of China increased its economic collaboration with Nigeria by signing a bilateral agreement worth 8.2 million Yuan in 2016 for feasibility studies on the second phase of the Abuja Solar Powered Traffic Control Signal, Agricultural Demonstration Center, and the bilateral training programs. The project will be funded through gratis assistance as part of the 2012 Economic and Technical Cooperation Agreement between the two governments. According to the agreement, RMB Yuan 6000,000.00 is allocated for training programmes (project #52629); the Agricultural Centre is allocated RMB Yuan 1,000,000.00 (project #52630), while the Solar project study has RMB Yuan 1,200,000.00 (project #52632). The Nigerian Government was responsible for providing technical data which the feasibility study requires, logistics, and designating a specialized organization to coordinate the Chinese team.
leads.staff_comments: This project is an umbrella project to projects #52629, #52630, #52632. The states of the individual projects are unknown.

leads.title: Henan Provincial Government signs MoU with State Government of Sokoto to establish Agricultural Demonstration Area
leads.place: Sokoto State
leads.description: In April 2016, the State Government of Sokoto signed a memorandum of understanding with the Henan Province government to establish an agricultural demonstration area (农业示范区) to promote development of agriculture in Sokoto. The project includes a joint expert team to research on climate, soil, crop cultivation techniques and quarantine protection; it also aims to expand the use of machinery. The Chinese Government’s Economic and Commercial Counselor’s Office (ECCO) has indicated that this project is one of the 100 agricultural projects announced by President Xi at the South-South Cooperation Conference in September 2015.
leads.staff_comments: This project in the State of Sokoto should not be confused with agricultural demonstration centers in other Northern/Northwestern states, such as the one in project #52630.

leads.title: China provides grant for Pilot Project Of Digital Terrestrial Multimedia Broadcast (DTMB) (linked to #72696)
leads.place: China provides grant for Pilot Project Of Digital Terrestrial Multimedia Broadcast.  More detailed locational information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/16108358
leads.description: According to the Pakistan Ministry of Finance, China and Pakistan signed a memorandum of understanding to expand the Digital Terrestrial Multimedia Broadcast (DTMB).  As of 2018, the first phase of the project, a pilot DTMB installed at Remote Backup Service (RBS) in Murree by Chinese ZTE Corporation for demonstration of the Pakistan Television Corporation (PTV) terrestrial network, is completed. The project is financed through a grant of an unknown amount from the Chinese Ministry of Commerce.  The feasibility project had a reported cost of 0.70 million RMB and is completed, according to the Pakistani Economic Affairs Division Year Book for 2015/2016. It is recorded in project #72696.  According to the CPEC website, as of 2018 the total cost of the pilot project was $2 million, and the demonstration project is with funding from the Chinese side. The Pilot Project was inaugurated April 2015.  PC-1 of the Demonstration project approved by CDWP on 2nd May 2018.

leads.title: Chinese embassy donates food and materials to Somali IDP camps
leads.place: South Mogadishu, https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/34684808
leads.description: On September 5 2016, according to the Chinese Embassy, the Chinese Embassy in Somalia donated food and plastic sheets to Duaysane and Kun-Sali IDPs (Internally displaced persons) Camps in the south of Mogadishu through the Ministry of Interior and Federal Affairs of Somalia. 1,000 families each received 25 kilograms of sugar, 25 kilograms of rice, and 25 kilograms of wheat flour. Among them, 500 families received an extra 3 liters of cooking oil each, while the other 500 received one piece of plastic sheet._x000D_ _x000D_

leads.title: Asia Pacific Daily donates to Sri Lanka Ministry of Disaster Management following 2016 floods
leads.description: In May, 2016, Asia Pacific Daily donated an unknown amount of funds to the Sri Lanka Ministry of Disaster Management following extreme flooding in Sri Lanka. At least 102 people were killed in the floods. The disaster was recorded as one of the worst in Sri Lanka's history.
leads.staff_comments: 1. Asia Pacific Daily is a branch of the Chinese state-controlled Xinhua News Agency.

leads.title: Chinese Embassy provides emergency grant assistance to the Druze Church
leads.place: This project provided donations of emergency aid to the Druze Church in the state of Jabal al-Druze. More detailed locational information can be found at https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/573511614.
leads.description: On February 3, 2016, the Chinese Embassy in Syria signed a handover certificate for the donation of emergency aid to the Druze Church in the state of Jabal al-Druze. The aid included quilts, blankets, and other materials.   The Druze community of Syria is believed to constitute an estimated 3.2 percent of the Syria population (as of 2010), or approximately 700,000 persons including the Golan Heights. The Druze are concentrated in the rural, mountainous areas east and south of Damascus in the area known officially as Jabal al-Druze. Druze Church has played an important role in local refugee resettlement and humanitarian relief activities.

leads.title: China provided assistance to Tonga for the fourth phase of the China-Tonga Agriculture Demonstration Farm Project (linked to projects #37707, #39248, #39241, #65028)
leads.description: Beginning in 2016, a series of inspections of the Chinese-Tongan agricultural demonstration farm have taken place. These included two visits by Tongan King Tupou VI, and two from the Chinese Ambassador to Tonga. During these visits it was reported that the agricultural demonstration farm is now in its fourth phase, involving the construction of new open-air vegetable fields and vegetable greenhouses, the repair of pig houses and biogas digesters, the laying of drip irrigation facilities and the construction of simple roads in the demonstration area. This project is linked to #37707, which records additional funding for the piggery at the farm. It is also linked to #39248, #39241, and #65028, which record phases 1, 2, and 3 of the farm respectively.  On June 7, 2017, Ambassador Wang Baodong visited the farm to inspect the fourth phase of Tonga's agricultural technical cooperation project.

leads.title: 3rd batch of Chinese agricultural experts in Burundi
leads.place: No locational information available at this time.
leads.description: In Nov 2015, 6 experts and 2 interpreters arrived in Burundi as the 3rd Chinese high-level agricultural expert team. They have expertise in the demonstration fields of rice, livestock, aquaculture, soil and fertilizer, veterinary and agricultural machinery. Their mission was completed in Nov 2017. Since 2009, China has sent tens of agricultural experts to provide technical assistance._x000D_ _x000D_ Linked to 1st #32967, 2nd #62292, and 4th #57563.

leads.title: Chinese Government provides assistance for Phase II of Solar Power Demonstration Project (Linked to Project ID#53193)
leads.place: The purpose of this project was for the Chinese Government to provide assistance for Phase II of the Solar Power Demonstration Project in Praia. More detailed locational information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/28095099
leads.description: On November 7, 2014, Chinese and Cabo Verdean government officials signed meeting notes in regards to a feasibility study for phase II of a solar demonstration project (中国援佛得角太阳能示范后续合作项目 or 太阳能光伏项目) in Praia. When China formally committed financing and how much is unknown. The flow type is never specified, but phase II is most likely financed by grants or interest-free loans from the Chinese government.  On December 4, 2015, China Railway 17th Bureau Group Electrification Engineering Co. and the Cabo Verde Minister of Foreign Affairs signed an implementation contract for this follow-up project. The handover certificate was signed on December 1, 2016. This project was divided into three parts: (1) installing a 2 kW photovoltaic lighting system for the Poilao Dam (#237) management house, (2) 15 solar-powered lights for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs courtyard, and (3) 120 kW solar panels for government office buildings.  China also funded phase I (#53193) of this project.
leads.staff_comments: Given that this project is described by official sources as 'China-aided', AidData assumes that it was funded through a MOFCOM grant or interest-free loan. The flow_class field is therefore set to ODA-Like because the project has development intent and grants and interest-free loans from MOFCOM always exceed the OECD concessionality threshold of 25%.

leads.title: Chinese military deploys military medical team to Ethiopia (1st)
leads.place: The purpose of this project was to deploy a military medical team to Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. More detailed locational information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/13422232
leads.description: On January 12, 2015, a Chinese military medical expert team was sent to Addis Ababa, Ethiopia, to provide a one-year medical assistance to the General Hospital of the Ethiopian National Defense Force (ENDF). This marked the first Chinese military medical expert team to Ethiopia. The team consisted of eight experts dispatched from the People's Liberation Army (PLA) Third Military Medical University. During their time in Ethiopia, the team undertook the tasks including outpatient service, group consultation, surgical operations, emergency treatment as well as professional training for medical workers in seven departments of the General Hospital of ENDF including the internal medicine-cardiovascular department, the neurosurgery department and the otolaryngology department. According to China Military News, the Chinese military medical experts received and treated outpatients for 4,000 persons/times, saved lives of 63 critically ill patients and performed surgery operations or provided surgery operation guidance 220 times without any cases of death or malpractice. The Chinese military medical team returned to China on January 12, 2016.

leads.title: Grenada Agricultural Technology Cooperation Project Phase 5 (linked to #54764)
leads.place: The China-Grenada Agriculture Demonstration Center is located at La Sagesse Beach in St. David. More detailed locational information can be found at https://www.alamy.com/a-sign-announces-chinese-economic-aid-for-the-construction-of-a-grenadian-government-agriculture-building-at-la-sagesse-beach-grenada-china-shanxi-sijian-group-offers-financial-aid-to-the-grenadian-government-for-funding-infrastructure-projects-such-as-ports-highways-airports-a-national-sports-stadium-and-government-subsidized-housing-image178558333.html and https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/4578065295
leads.description: From Sept 21, 2015 - Sept 20, 2017 Suntime International Techno-Economic Cooperation (Group) Co., Ltd. is the group recognized for spearheading knowledge and technology exchange efforts between China and Grenada. Phase 5 ended with a visit from 8 agricultural technical experts sent from China. From September 19-28, they carried out vegetable/flower demonstrations, livestock/poultry demonstrations, technical guidance and training, repair/maintenance of agricultural machinery, and donated various materials (machines, tools, irrigation equipment, livestock/farming equipment, seedlings). The group also assessed the overall project progress and reported back to China's Economic and Commercial Counselor's Office. At the end of the visit on Sept 28, an initial Phase 6 acceptance was started.
leads.staff_comments: This project is linked to umbrella project #54764. It ties into the wider Grenada Agricultural Technical Cooperation Project effort established from 2005 which aims to share agricultural technology and knowledge between China and Grenada.

leads.title: Chinese Government dispatches third police peacekeeping riot team to Liberia in 2015
leads.description: On March 11, 2015, the Chinese Government dispatched China's third peacekeeping police riot team to Liberia for a one-year term as a Formed Police Unit (FPU) under the United Nations Mission in Liberia (UNMIL). The team consisted of 140 members drawn from the Shandong Provincial Public Security Border Defense Corps. The team arrived at Jinan Yaoqiang International Airport by chartered flight to complete the peacekeeping mission. In addition to peacekeeping missions, the team members also donated supplies for cultural and sports activities to the resident schools; participated in the commemorations of UN Peacekeeper Day and UN Day; performed tactical demonstrations, martial arts, gongs and drums, and national instrumental music performances to spread Chinese culture. The team returned on March 12, 2016.

leads.title: Chinese Government agrees to dispatch 11 experts to conduct technical cooperation activities in support of the Agricultural Technology Demonstration Center (Linked to Project ID #32636 and #67681)
leads.place: This project supported the Agricultural Technology Demonstration Center in Mbagne (M’bagne), which is a town and commune in the Brakna Region of southern Mauritania. More detailed location information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/1990547260
leads.description: On December 18, 2015, the Chinese Government agreed to dispatch 11 experts to the Agricultural Technology Demonstration Center (see Project ID#32636) in Mbagne (M’bagne) as part of a three-year technical cooperation agreement. The purpose of their technical cooperation mission was to undertake experimental research and train Mauritanian personnel. The grant funds for this project were drawn from an Economic and Technical Cooperation Agreement (ETCA) signed by the Chinese Government and the Government of Mauritania on December 18, 2015 (see Project ID#67681). On March 14, 2016, the Ministry of Commerce sent an 8-person inspection team from China Urban Construction Design & Research Institute to conduct a feasibility study on the second phase of the water treatment project (sewage discharge and treatment) in Nouakchott, the capital of Mauritius. Current implementation status of the project is unknown.

leads.title: [umbrella project] China signed Economic and Technical Cooperation Agreement for Capital Wastewater Feasibility study, Agricultural Technology Demonstration Center aid, and Government Office Building aid (linked to #57063, #56900, and #67682)
leads.description: On December 12, 2015, an Economic and Technical Cooperation Agreement was signed between the Chinese Government and the Government of Mauritania, for an unspecified amount. The ETCA funded a feasibility study for the Capital Wastewater Project (see project #56900), experts for assistance at the Agricultural Technology Demonstration Center (see project #57063), and experts to carry out the third phase of the Government Office Building assistance (see project #67682).

leads.title: China’s Ministry of Science and Technology provides technical assistance for Biomass Demonstration Project
leads.place: The purpose of this project was to provides technical assistance for Biomass Demonstration Project. This project is located in Amyang Village, Liangdong Township, and Ayeyarwady Province,in Myanmar. More detailed locational information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/5996532 and https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/5996473
leads.description: China's Ministry of Science and Technology provided technical assistance toward the 200 KW Biomass Gasification Power Generation Project in Myanmar. The project was started in 2015, and was completed on August 30, 2018 when the ribbon-cutting ceremony for the power generator's trial run was held. This project involved creating a 200 KW biomass gasification power generator.  The project is located in Amyang Village, Liangdong Township, Ayeyarwady Province, Myanmar. The demonstration project has an installed capacity of 200 kilowatts, and will provide electricity to the rice processing plant and surrounding villages where it is located. It is expected that through the demonstration effect of the project, the establishment of more biomass gasification power generation project bases will be promoted to make greater contributions to resource utilization, energy conservation, and environmental protection projects in Myanmar and Southeast Asia. The biomass gasification power generator is expected to convert waste paddy husk into electricity without any harm to the environment, and can run for 24 consecutive hours for one month. This project is completed.  The project is referred to as 生物质

leads.title: Chinese Government provides grant for Nigerian Refugee Skill Acquisition Centre in the New Kuchingoro IDP Camp
leads.place: New Kuchingoro IDP Camp is located in Kaura (Games Village) 900103, Abuja, Federal Capital Territory, Nigeria. More detailed locational information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/11184764858
leads.description: On October 9, 2015, a Refugee Skill Aquisition Center (难民营技能培训中心) was established at the New Kuchingoro IDP (Internally Displaced Persons) Camp in the suburbs of Abuja. The Nigerian Refugee Skill Aquisition Centre was launched by the Chinese Embassy in cooperation "尼日利亚州议员联合会" , the National Association of State Assembly Legislators of Nigeria. _x000D_ _x000D_ The project aims to provide 400 women and youth living in the refugee camp with technical training in sewing, hairdressing, soap making, and generator repair._x000D_ _x000D_

leads.title: Ningxia University establishes 'Key Laboratory of Resource Evaluation and Environmental Regulation in Arid Areas' in Oman
leads.description: In 2015, Ningxia University and the University of Oman jointly established the "Key Laboratory of Resource Evaluation and Environmental Regulation in Arid Areas". The laboratory will be used for research and development of new products suitable for the needs and characteristics of Oman. The project included donations of technology and new equipment, a 150-square-meter laboratory, and a 200-mu demonstration base. The monetary value of Ningxia University's contribution to this project is unknown.  Since the laboratory's establishment, advanced water-saving technology and equipment have been promoted in 13 farms. It is noted that the laboratory was established with the support of the China-Arab Technology Transfer Center.

leads.title: China holds Cotton Technology Overseas Training Course in Sudan
leads.place: Al Qadarif
leads.description: On August 24th , the “2015 Sudan Cotton Technology Overseas Training Course,” sponsored by the Ministry of Commerce of the People's Republic of China, was successfully launched using the Agricultural Technology Demonstration Center which was built by China in Sudan._x000D_ _x000D_ The agricultural center was constructed with assistance from China in 2009 (Project #53414).

leads.title: CDB expresses interest in financing $1.2 billion Zambia-Kenya-Tanzania Power Interconnector Project
leads.place: More detailed locational information can be found at https://aid.nepad.org/m_assets/uploads/document/1511539110869816340.pdf.
leads.description: In 2014, the Governments of Zambia, Tanzania and Kenya agreed to interconnect their power systems by constructing a high voltage Alternating Current (AC) transmission line, traversing the three countries over a total distance of 2,300km. The project will seek to link the Eastern African Power Pool (EAPP) with the Southern African Power Pool (SAPP). This larger Zambia-Tanzania-Kenya Power Interconnector project will be developed through a 400kV double circuit power transmission line in Kenya and Tanzania while the segment in Zambia will be constructed as two single 330kV circuits. The voltage transformation will be at the proposed Nakonde 400kV / 330kV substation in Zambia located approximately 14km from the Tanzania-Zambia border.   On December 14, 2014, a Tripartite Inter-Governmental Memorandum of Understanding (TIGMOU) was signed by the three countries in which the three countries agreed to develop the project. It was agreed that each country would develop the segment of the project within its boundaries. Prospective funders of the project include Common Market for Eastern and Southern Africa (COMESA), World Bank, African Development Bank, and China Development Bank (CDB)  The p

leads.title: China donates forestry material to Cambodia
leads.place: The project was to donate forestry protection supplies worth thousands of US dollars to Cambodia's Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries’ Forest Industry (MAFF). More detailed locational information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/204350658
leads.description: China donated forestry protection supplies worth thousands of US dollars to Cambodia's Ministry of Agriculture, Forestry and Fisheries’ Forest Industry (MAFF). The donation aims to help protect the Cambodia’s forests and improve MAFF's management in forest resources. The donation includes computers, firetrucks, patrol cars, and handheld GPS locators. The handover ceremony was held on September 2, 2014 in Phnom Penh. _x000D_ _x000D_ While while China’s donation has been hailed as a sign of support in the fight against deforestation, the country is also alleged to be one of the biggest drivers behind the destruction of Cambodia’s most precious timber. _x000D_

leads.title: Chinese Donation of Environmental Monitoring Equipment to Cuba
leads.description: On July 22nd, 2014, China agreed to donate environmental monitoring equipment to Cuba, as one of a lengthy series of accords signed during Chinese President Xi Jinping's visit to the island nation. The agreement was signed by Elba Rosa Pérez Montoya of the Ministry of Science, Technology and Environment of Cuba and Zhang Tuo of the Ministry of Environmental Protection of China. Its stipulations were fulfilled on October 29th, 2015, when three fixed air quality monitoring stations were installed in Havana: one at the headquarters of the San Miguel del Padrón Municipal Administration Council; one at the Instituto Superior de Tecnologías y Ciencias Aplicadas; and one at the Cuban Meteorological Institute (INSMET), under the responsibility of one of its institutions, the Center for Atmospheric Contamination and Chemistry Studies (CECQA). Fernando Mario González Bermúdez, First Deputy Minister of the Ministry of Science, Technology and the Environment (CITMA); and Wu Xiaquing, China's Vice Minister of Environmental Protection, signed the delivery certificate.
leads.staff_comments: This may be linked to a 2005 MOU according to Source ID #186161.

leads.title: Cuba-China Agriculture Demonstration Farm (linked to #70895)
leads.description: On 22 July, 2014, Han Changfu from the Chinese Ministry of Agriculture and Rodríguez Rollero of the Cuban Ministry of Agriculture signed a framework agreement on the Cuba-China Crop and Animal Farming Demonstration Park.  China and Cuba agreed to jointly develop this park in Cuba._x000D_ _x000D_ This agreement follows a 2012 MOU for the 'Agricultural Cooperation Plan' (Plan de Cooperación Agrícola) between the governments of China and Cuba captured in umbrella project #70895.

leads.title: China donates medical materials to Gabon to fight Ebola
leads.place: The purpose of this project was to donate medical materials to prevent Ebola contamination to the Libreville hospital. More detailed locational information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/2804109
leads.description: On Sept 25, 2014, the Chinese ambassador to Gabon, Sun Jiwen, handed over medical materials to Gabon for the prevention of Ebola contamination to the Libreville hospital. The donation had initially been turned back for having passed through Nigeria, a country "banned" by Gabon due to the Ebola outbreak that has claimed some lives. The Chinese ambassador said the donation was part of China's total aid of US$ 30 million to African countries affected or threatened by the deadly virus. The exact transaction amount is unknown.

leads.title: Chinese Government provides grant for Phase II of the Nongo Stadium Construction Project (Linked to #2372)
leads.place: Nongo Stadium — also known as General Lansana Conté Stadium — is located in Kaloum Peninsula in the capital city of Conakry. More detailed locational information can be found at https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/7829658
leads.description: Around 2014, the Chinese Government agreed to provide a grant for Phase II of the Nongo Stadium (Stade Nongo) Construction Project. The monetary value of this grant is unknown. Phase I is captured in project #60578. The stadium was later renamed the General Lansana Conté Stadium.  In 2004, the Chinese Government agreed to provided an RMB 360 million grant to the Government of Guinea for Phase I of the Nongo Stadium (Stade Nongo) Construction Project (#60578). In 2004, Central-South Architectural Design Institute Co. (CSADI, 中南建筑设计院) began designing the 50,000-person stadium. Shanghai Construction Group General Co. (上海建工集团总公司) was responsible for project implementation. Phase I works began on Sep 18, 2007 and ended in late 2011. The official handover ceremony was held on January 18, 2012.  The stadium has a total area of 240,000 square meters and a total construction area of 34,000 square meters. There are eight standard track and field stadiums with 400-meter tracks, as well as long jump, high jump, pole vault, triple jump, shot put, hammer throw, discus, javelin, obstacle race and other track and field facilities. There is a standard football field in the central area with a large
leads.staff_comments: Other project names: Stade Nongo or Stade Général Lansana Conté or 几内亚体育场 or 援几内亚科纳克里体育场第二期建.This facility is also called the General Lansana Conté Stadium or Unity Stadium or Conakry Stadium.

leads.title: China provides medical training to Guyanese doctors
leads.place: Chinese doctors were sent to teach at the University of Guyana's School of Medicine.  More detailed locational information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/816669649
leads.description: On September 27, 2014, China’s Minister of National Health and Family Planning, Li Bin, and Guyana’s Health Minister Dr. Bheri Ramsaran sign the five-year Memorandum of Understanding on promoting cooperation in health policy, human resource training, and disease control. The agreement calls for Chinese specialists to train doctors and medical personnel from Guyana, while the Guyanese government will invite Chinese instructors to offer courses at the University of Guyana's School of Medicine. The overall objective of the agreement is to reduce maternal mortality in Guyana, reducing the number of deaths by 75%.

leads.title: Chinese Formed Police Unit Donate Sports Equipment and School Supplies to Sinoe Multilateral High School (linked to project ID#90317)
leads.place: Greenville, Liberia
leads.description: On May 27, 2014, Chinese Peacekeepers from the UN mission in Liberia visited Sinoe Multilateral High School. The monetary value of the donation is unclear, but they donated footballs. stationary, books, and book bags to the school. They also preformed a martial arts demonstration.

leads.title: China sends peacekeepers to Mali to help after plane crash
leads.place: Gossi
leads.description: On July 25, 2014, China sent its first batch of peacekeepers to help after the fatal plane crash of Air Algerie flight AH5017. They are mainly responsible for transferring and refrigerating the bodies. The site of the accident, the Gossi area, was 60 km away from where the Chinese mission is stationed. China sent 30 people, 5 pieces of engineering machinery, and 15 carrier vehicles in the assistance work.

leads.title: Chinese Government provides assistance for the construction of the China-Myanmar Agricultural Demonstration Center
leads.description: According to the news release from the Ministry of Foreign Affair of China and the Ministry of Finance of China, Myanmar and China decided to establish the China-Myanmar Agricultural Cooperation Committee in 2014 and advance the progress of constructing an Agricultural Demonstration Center. The formation of the committee is under the instruction of the "Joint Statement of the People's Republic of China and the Federal Republic of Myanmar on Deepening Comprehensive Strategic Cooperation between the Two Countries," which was signed on November 2014. _x000D_ _x000D_ Based on the news release from the Embassy of China in Myanmar, On August 9, 2015, Chinese Ambassador to Myanmar Hong Liang visited Naypyidaw and inspected 100-standard agricultural demonstration fields. It is unclear if these demonstration fields will be part of the Demonstration Center. No progress on the demonstration center has been reported. However, there were reports that Yunnan Yuntianhua Company signed an agreement with Myanmar's Ministry of Agriculture in 2018 to construct agricultural demonstration fields. It is unclear if this is part of the agricultural demonstration center project.
leads.staff_comments: Project coded as pledge for now as there is no evidence of an official commitment.

leads.title: Chinese Government provides grant for Phase 3 of the China-Samoa Agricultural Demonstration Farm Project (Linked to Project ID#49231, #49190, and #61282)
leads.place: The purpose of Phase 3 was to provide farming machinery, repair damage to buildings causes by Cyclone Evan in 2012, establish an agricultural technology station (complete with irrigation tanks, greenhouses, and vegetable sheds) in the village of Falelatai on Upolu Island, and showcase agricultural technologies that can be used by farmers. More detailed locational information can be found at https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/388962768#map=17/-13.90909/-172.02995
leads.description: In 2014, the Chinese Government provided a grant to the Government of Samoa for Phase 3 of the China-Samoa Agricultural Demonstration Farm Project. The monetary value of the grant commitment is unknown.   The purpose of Phase 3 was to provide farming machinery, repair damage to buildings causes by Cyclone Evan in 2012, establish an agricultural technology station (complete with irrigation tanks, greenhouses, and vegetable sheds) in the village of Falelatai on Upolu Island, and showcase agricultural technologies that can be used by farmers.   The ultimate aim of the project was to improve local farmers' earnings and enhance food security by reducing reliance on imported foods and encouraging the transfer and adoption of modern and more effective agricultural practices to village farmers. Hunan Provincial Agricultural Foreign Economic Cooperation Center was the contractor responsible for implementation. Phase 3 commenced in 2014. The Falelatai agricultural station was officially inaugurated on October 11, 2016 and then handed over to the local authorities from October 15, 2016 to October 16, 2016.
leads.staff_comments: Staff Note 1: This project is also known as Phase 3 of the Samoa-China Agricultural Technical Aid Project (SCATAP), Phase 3 of the Samoa-China Agriculture Development Demonstration Farm Project, the Third Phase of the China Samoa Agricultural Technical Cooperation Project, Phase 3 of the Vegetable Garden Project, and the Agriculture Station at Faleatai Project. Staff Note 2: This project initially consisted of four phases, all of which are complete. Project ID#49231 captures Phase 1. Project ID#49190 captures Phase 2. Project ID#61281 captures Phase 3. Project ID#61282 captures Phase 4. Phase 5 is now underway.

leads.title: [EBOLA] China sent 12 public health trainers to fight Ebola in Sierra Leone
leads.place: The purpose of the project is to send 12 public health trainers to fight Ebola in Sierra Leone. More detailed location information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/314868716
leads.description: On November 10, 2014, China sent the first team of 12 public health trainers to help fight Ebola in Sierra Leone. China planned to send over 1,000 medical workers and experts to West Africa in the coming months in its latest bid to aid African countries' fight against the Ebola virus. The public health trainers will train 4000 common villagers, help build demonstration bases, and the Bio-safety III lab P3. They worked in Sierra Leone for 3 months.

leads.title: China military hospital ship provides medical services to Tonga (linked to project #65343)
leads.place: Nuku’alofa, Vuna Wharf, ‘Eua Island
leads.description: On August 13, the Peace Ark hospital ship of the Chinese People’s Liberation Army Navy arrived at the port of Nukualofa, Vuna Wharf in Tonga for a 7-day visit. While providing various medical services, the hospital ship also sent its medical team to local hospitals to carry out surgical operations in cooperation with the medical staff of Tonga, and set up medical teams to pay rounds of visits to remote islands and islets to provide diagnosis and treatment services. In addition, it also sent its teams to local schools and centers for the disabled to give diagnosis and treatment and carry out donation activities. The ship departed on Wednesday, 20 August after a week of providing free medical services that included 39 surgeries, including removing a bullet from a Tongan who had been shot while he was in the United States. Medical teams were also dispatched to the Vaiola Hospital. Patients on ‘Eua Island also received free assistance when a team flew to the island on board the vessel’s medical helicopter._x000D_

leads.title: China provided assistance to Tonga for the third phase of the China-Tonga Agriculture Demonstration Farm Project (linked to projects #37707, #39248, #39241, #65029)
leads.description: After receiving an inspection from Zhu Wen of Hunan International Construction Engineering Co., Ltd in 2014, a chicken donation ceremony was held as the third phase of the agricultural demonstration farm in Tonga on July 17, 2015. This involved a donation of 2,100 chickens and seed, following up on previous donations totaling 11,000 chickens from China to Tonga. This project is linked to #37707, which records additional funding for the piggery at the farm. It is also linked to #39248, #39241, #65029, which record phases 1, 2, and 4 of the agricultural demonstration farm respectively._x000D_

leads.title: China Eximbank reschedules Tranche 1 of buyer’s credit loan for Aerial Express Project via 2-year grace period extension (Linked to Project ID#42494 and ID#67775)
leads.place: The purpose of the Aerial Express Project was to construct a 4.752 km passenger railway from Boryspil International Airport (BIA) to the capital city of Kiev. More detailed locational information can be found at: https://uk.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kyiv_Boryspil_Express#/map/0 and https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/596366492 and https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/309203360
leads.description: On September 3, 2010, the Government of Ukraine’s State Investment Agency and the Export-Import Bank of China (China Eximbank) signed a loan framework agreement regarding the Aerial Express Project. Then, on July 5, 2011, China Eximbank and SC "National Project "Airexpress" (Ukrainian: «Дирекція з будівництва та управління національного проекту «Повітряний експрес») — a project company and special purpose vehicle (SPV) wholly-owned by the Government of Ukraine — signed a $372,313,538 buyer’s credit loan agreement [№ BLA201123] for the Aerial Express Project. The borrowing terms of this loan were as follows: a 15 year maturity, a 3 year grace period, and an interest rate of 6-month LIBOR (0.414% in July 2011) plus a 3.5% margin. Ukraine’s Cabinet of Ministers issued a sovereign guarantee in support of the loan on June 16, 2011. SC "National Project "Airexpress" also purchased buyer’s credit insurance from Sinosure on July 25, 2012 (at an additional cost of $36.39 million). The China Eximbank loan was split into two tranches. The first tranche was worth $52,123,895 and it was earmarked for design and preparatory work (phase 1 of the project). The second tranche was worth $320,189,643
leads.staff_comments: This project is also known as the Ukrainian Air Express Airport Railway Project and the Rail Transit linking Borispol International Airport Project and the Kyiv Boryspil Express Project. The Ukrainian project title is 'Дирекція з будівництва та управління національного проекту 'Повітряний експрес' та інших інфраструктурних об'єктів Київського регіону”. The Chinese project title is 空中快车 or 《空中快车》项目.

leads.title: China Africa Sunlight Energy Company (CASECO) pledges $53 million loan for Gwayi-Shangani Dam Project (linked to #63463)
leads.place: The Gwayi-Shangani Dam Project is located in Zimbabawe’s Hwange District and Matabeleland North Province. The dam site is located at about 6 km downstream on the confluence of Gwayi and Shangani Rivers. It has a catchment area of close to 38,000 square kilometres – extending from Gweru, Bulawayo, Tsholotsho, Nkayi and Silobela.
leads.description: In 2014, China Africa Sunlight Energy Company (CASECO or 中非阳光能源有限公司) signed an MOU with Zimbabwe National Water Authority.  It agreed in principle to provide a $53 million USD loan for the Gwayi-Shangani Dam Project.  The Government of Zimbabwe would reportedly repay the loan through future sales of water.  CASECO’s future water consumption bill (due to its implementation of the Gwayi Integrated Coal Mine and Thermal Power Station Project, see Project ID#63463) would also reportedly offset against the $53 million USD loan.  The purpose of the project is to facilitate construction of the Gwayi-Shangani Dam.  More specifically, it will involve grouting of dam foundations, installation of outlet pipes and valves, and the construction of a concrete dam wall.  Upon completion, the dam will store up to 30 million cubic liters of water and enable the CASECO to draw water from the dam.  The Gwayi-Shangani Dam Project is part of a larger initiative called The National Matabeleland Zambezi Water Project (NMZWP), which is a project being undertaken in the arid Matabeleland North province of Zimbabwe to end the perennial water shortages affecting the city of Bulawayo by bringing water from the
leads.staff_comments: While construction for this project is underway, there is no evidence that this $53 million USD loan was ever actually provided to the Zimbabwean Government, which is why AidData codes the loan as Pipeline: Pledge.

leads.title: China constructs an agricultural demonstration center at UWI St. Augustine (linked to project #39946)
leads.place: America, regional; Trinidad and Tobago (St. Augustine)
leads.description: On June 2, 2013, Chinese President Xi Jinping pledged to built one to two demonstration centers within the next three years to showcase agricultural technologies. The pledge was made at a luncheon with leaders of Trinidad, Tobago, Suriname, Guyana, Dominica, Barbados, Jamaica, the Bahamas, Grenada, Antigua, and Barbuda. This pledge resulted in a Memorandum of Understanding on December 10, 2014 between the University of the West Indies (UWI) and China Agricultural University (CAU) to establish a 200 acre Agricultural Innovation Park at UWI St. Augustine. _x000D_ _x000D_ The park is set to contain technology service, horticulture, aquatic production, mini zoo, leisure and recreation and commercial entertainment zones. The agreement also provided for joint collaboration between the parties in training graduate students at the master and doctoral level, as well as the possibility of a Joint Degree Program. The first stage of the facility, an innovation focused teaching farm, opened on October 23 2015. It has been experimenting with a variety of Chinese crops and has begun developing methods for sustainable intensive agriculture in an island setting. In 2018, the farm additionally start

leads.title: China donates guns and ammunition to Cambodia National Police
leads.description: On July 30, 2013, the Chinese Government and the Cambodia National Police under the Ministry of Interior signed a memoradum of understanding (MOU) in which China pledged to donate 1,000 handguns, 50,000 bullets, and other unspecified equipment to the Cambodia side. The monetary value of this donation is unknown and it is unclear whether the goods were ever delivered.   This signing ceremony occured during a period of political unrest related to elections.

leads.title: Chinese Government provides grant for Dumasi-Niefang Agricultural Demonstration Farm Project
leads.place: The Dumasi-Niefang Agricultural Demonstration Farm Project is located in the town of Niefang. More detailed locational information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/667646869
leads.description: In 2013, the Chinese Government reportedly provided a grant to the Government of Equatorial Guinea for the Dumasi-Niefang Agricultural Demonstration Farm Project. The monetary value of this grant is unknown.  On October 20, 2015, Jiangxi Ganliang Industrial Ltd. completed the project. It was officially handed over to Equatorial Guinea’s Ministry of Agriculture and Forestry of Equatorial Guinea on March 4, 2016.   Jiangxi Ganliang Industrial Ltd. selected agricultural experts to carry out crop diversification cultivation, improved seed breeding, production and processing demonstration, technology promotion and personnel training at the Dumasi-Niefang Agricultural Demonstration Farm in the town of Niefang. The farm covers an area of 52 hectares. The agricultural expert group launched a rice planting experiment in November 2017. Then, in May 2018, Dumasi-Niefang Agricultural Demonstration Farm grew a rice crop successfully for the first time in the history of the country. In order to promote the cultivation of rice within 10 acres of farmland, the Chinese agricultural expert group selected 4 high-yield  rice varieties suitable for local planting. It overcame various difficulties, incl
leads.staff_comments: 1. This project is also known as the Dumassi-Niefang Agricultural Demonstration Farm Project. 2. The Chinese project title is 援赤几涅方示范农场项目. 3. The Spanish project title is La Granja Piloto y Experimental Agricola de Dumassi-Niefang or La Granja Piloto de Niefang or La Granja de Dumasi.

leads.title: Chinese Government provides grant for Drip Irrigation Demonstration Project
leads.description: In 2013, the Chinese Government and the Government of Eritrea signed a cooperation agreement related to a Drip Irrigation Demonstration Project. The face value of the grant that the Chinese Government committed for this project is unknown.   The project involved the piloting of water-saving irrigation technologies on a 20 hectare plot of land. Xinjiang Tianye (Group) Co., Ltd. was the contractor responsible for implementation. The project commenced in December 2014 and ended on February 25, 2015.
leads.staff_comments: The Chinese project title is 厄农业节水滴灌示范项目 or 援助厄立特里亚节水灌溉项目.

leads.title: CDB reschedules $500 million loan to DBK via interest rate reduction (Linked to Project ID#96061)
leads.place: CDB reschedules a loan to DBK via interest rate reduction.  More detailed locational information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/240376657
leads.description: On August 1, 2009, the Export-Import Bank of China (China Eximbank) entered into a master facility agreement (MFA) with the Development Bank of Kazakhstan JSC (DBK). China Eximbank permitted DBK to draw down up to $5 billion from the MFA, which included an unrestricted $1.5 billion loan tranche (captured via Project ID#53547) and a restricted $3.5 billion loan tranche (captured via Project ID#54797). The MFA covered a period of up to 15 years and it prohibited DBK from incurring indebtedness exceeding 25% of its assets or disposing of over 25% of its assets, in addition to a change of control clause favoring China Eximbank. The restricted portion of the MFA was for projects with a ‘Chinese component’ (i.e. involving the purchase of Chinese goods and services), whereas the unrestricted portion was for DBK’s general purposes.   Under the restricted portion of the MFA, on September 29, 2009, DBK entered into an individual buyer’s credit loan (BCL) agreement (ID#BLA0927) with China Eximbank worth $3.5 billion. This BCL carried the following borrowing terms: a maturity period of 10 years (final maturity date: July 21, 2019) and a floating interest rate. As of late July 2009, the interes

leads.title: Chinese Government grant for the China-Laos Joint Laboratory for the Development and Utilization of Renewable Energy in Laos
leads.place: Chinese Government grant for the China-Laos Joint Laboratory for the Development and Utilization of Renewable Energy in Laos.  More detailed locational information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/184254434
leads.description: In September 2013, construction on the China-Laos Joint Laboratory for the Development and Utilization of Renewable Energy (or 中国-老挝可再生能源开发与利用联合实验室) began. The project is an aid project of the Chinese Ministry of Science and Technology. The project was implemented jointly by China's Yunnan Normal University and the Institute of Renewable Energy and New Materials of the Ministry of Science and Technology of Laos_x000D_ _x000D_ The inauguration ceremony for this project was held on January 19, 2018, and passed acceptance inspections on August 24, 2018._x000D_ _x000D_ The project intends to provide Laos with renewable energy experimental demonstration technologies and equipment to help jointly develop and utilize renewable energy, and implement the “ Belt and Road ” initiative and the China-ASEAN Science and Technology Partnership Program.

leads.title: Chinese Embassy donates prosthetic limbs, blankets, and medical kits to the Libyan Red Crescent Society
leads.place: The Chinese Embassy donated prosthetic limbs, blankets, and medical kits to the Libyan Red Crescent Society.  More detailed locational information can be found at: Retrieving data. Wait a few seconds and try to cut or copy again.
leads.description: On December 17, 2013, the Chinese Ambassador to Libya, Li Zhiguo, donated prosthetic limbs, blankets, medical kits and other items to the Libyan Red Crescent Society on behalf of the Chinese Embassy of Libya. The humanitarian aid was intended for those disabled and displaced by Libya's February 17th Revolution (which saw the fall of Muammar Gaddafi's regime) in order to help them get through the winter.

leads.title: Ningxia Agriculture and Animal Husbandry Department funds construction of Animal Husbandry Technology Demonstration Center (linked to #60736)
leads.place: Wadnagar County, Mautraza Province
leads.description: The Ningxia Agriculture and Animal Husbandry Department granted funds for the construction of the Animal Husbandry Technology Demonstration Center in Wadnagar County, Mautraza Province. The project included the construction of office buildings, breeding demonstration areas, feed forage planting areas, and supporting infrastructure such as irrigation, drainage, and power supply. The value of the grant provided is unknown. _x000D_ _x000D_ The groundbreaking ceremony was held on November 22, 2013, and the completion ceremony was held on November 23, 2015. The official handing over ceremony did not occur until June 28, 2016. The main contractors of the demonstration center were Ningxia Jinfulai Sheep Industry Co., Ltd. (宁夏金福来羊产业有限公司), along with Ningxia Zhonghang Zhengfei Saiwaixiang Halal Food Company, Ningxia Baota Petrochemical Group, and Ningxia Yijian International Economy Technology Devlopment Co Ltd (宁夏伊建国际经济技术发展有限公司). See Project ID#60736 for technical cooperation.

leads.title: China implements phase 9 of technical cooperation for the Pohnpei Pilot Farm in Micronesia (Linked to Umbrella Project #64557)
leads.place: This project supported the Pohnpei Demonstration Farm in the town of Pohnlangas within the municipality of Madolenihmw on the island of Pohnpei. More detailed locational information can be found at https://www.google.com/maps/place/Chinese+Farm+Rd,+Pohnpei,+Federated+States+of+Micronesia/@6.837091,158.2939304,19z/data=!3m1!4b1!4m5!3m4!1s0x65d9b72ce5c52fa1:0x94238234ab7dd51f!8m2!3d6.8370897!4d158.2944776 and https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/551283648
leads.description: In 2013, Chinese and Micronesian government officials signed an exchange of letters for phase 9 of a technical cooperation project on the Pohnpei pilot farm (or Pohnpei Demonstration Farm or 援密第九期佩州示范农场技术合作项目) in Micronesia. Umbrella project #64557 captures all 11 phases of technical cooperation._x000D_ _x000D_ According to multiple articles dated November 2015, experts from Hunan International Engineering Construction Co. carried out phase 9 between November 2013 and November 2015. _x000D_ _x000D_ The farm is located in the state of Pohnpei spanning 80,000 square meters including 40,000 square meters of tropical rain forests. The farm cultivates crops like sakau, yam, taro, banana, and others. The remaining 40,000 square meters houses laboratories, offices, and greenhouses. The purpose of this bilateral cooperation is to train local Micronesian farmers, introduce new seeds, and transfer agricultural technology to increase productivity. Phase 9 focused on incorporating edible fungi and the experts also installed 12 biogas digestors. _x000D_

leads.title: Bejing Urban Construction Group provides relief to flood victims
leads.description: In early January of 2013, Mozambique was hit with massive flooding, causing 2000 deaths and 45,18 evacuees. Bejining Urban Construction Group helped in a variety of ways. The project department cooperated with FIPAG, a Mozambican water company, to dispatch on-site water trucks to the FIPAG water station 60 kilometers away, which then transported clean water to people in the refuge areas. The department was able to provide 62 cubic meters of drinking water, which helped more than 1,000 affected families. In addition, the office in Mozambique purchased a large number of disinfectants, watering cans, epidemic prevention knowledge manuals and other materials and sent them to the construction site and local disaster victims to ensure timely disinfection and health. The final donation was 300 T-shirts, 100 cold jackets and 100 sets of stationery and school bags collected by Chinese employees and given to the Mozambique victims.

leads.title: China provides training for 300 Afghan police officers
leads.description: On September 23, 2012, China signed an agreement with Afghanistan to provide training to 300 Afghan police officers over the next four years; the officers will be in China for the training. As of 2013, 45 Afghan police officers were receiving training in China on fighting drugs and riots. This number was expected to increase to 250 by 2015. The financial value and current status of this project are unknown.

leads.title: China sends a medical team to aid in alleviation of outbreak in Cambodia
leads.place: The project was to send a medical team to aid an outbreak of an intestinal virus in Phnom Penh, Cambodia. More detailed locational information can be found at:  https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/560229438
leads.description: A Chinese medical team has been sent to Cambodia to aid in alleviation of an outbreak of EV71, an intestinal virus. The four-member team, which consisted of experts from the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention and  Beijing Children's Hospital, arrived in Phnom Penh on July 12th 2012, Thursday morning with medical supplies. The Chinese team will assist Cambodian medical workers in analyzing the virus, treating patients, studying the epidemic and training local staff. _x000D_ _x000D_ Since April 2012, A severe form of hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) has killed 54 Cambodian children; a majority of the victims were tested positive for EV-71.

leads.title: Chinese Government provides grant for Agricultural Technology Demonstration Center Construction Project
leads.place: Ombella-M'Poko prefectureMore detailed locational information can be found at https://www.openstreetmap.org/relation/2954675
leads.description: On February 16, 2012, Chinese ambassador Sun Haichao and Central African Republic (CAR) Minister of International Cooperation Doroday Amy Marazapa signed a cooperation agreement to build a Agricultural Technology Demonstration Center in the prefecture of Ombella-M'Poko. The agreement stipulated that the Chinese Government would build the demonstration center free of charge. Shanxi International Economic & Technical Cooperation Corporation was the contractor responsible for implementation. The construction contract for the project was signed on December 5, 2012, and a groundbreaking ceremony was held on December 17, 2012. However, the project was later suspended due to violence and political instability in CAR. Then, on June 19, 2015, China’s Ambassador to CAR announced the resumption of project implementation.
leads.staff_comments: The French project title is la construction du Centre de démonstration agricole de Mpoko. The Chinese project title is 援中非农业示范中心项目.

leads.title: China donates emergency equipment to Congo following the March 2012 arms depot explosion
leads.place: The purpose of this project was to donate emergency equipment to Mpila in the Congo. More detailed locational information can be found at: https://www.openstreetmap.org/node/3295662335
leads.description: On 4 March 2012, an arms depot in Mpila run by the Congolese armed forces exploded. It killed 280 people, injured 2,500 people, and wrecked neighborhoods in seven different localities. In response, the Chinese government donated 480 insecticide-treated mosquito nets, 80 transistor radios, and 8 solar-powered streetlights to assist victims and newly homeless. The value of this donation is unknown.   China also donated 3 million USD to Congo following the blast (#30708).

leads.title: China conducts feasibility study for constructing Guiguidou Agricultural Demonstration Center in Cote d'Ivoire
leads.description: In February 2012, China carried out a feasibility study to establish an agricultural demonstration center (格格杜农业示范中心 or centre de démonstration agricole rizicole de Guiguidou) in Guiguidou, a rice reclamation area spanning 432 hectares near Divo in Lôh-Djiboua region. According to a November 2013 press release from the Government of the PRC, plans were still in preparation stages and the article described the project as combining government aid with a marketized demonstration operation. According to Xavier Auregan's research, this project will be financed by an interest-free loan from the Chinese Government. The Guiguidou operational center is the largest Chinese-run center in Africa spanning 442 hectares. _x000D_ _x000D_ The November 2013 Government of the PRC press release says this project is different from Chinese Agricultural Technical Assistance Missions (MATAC) to Guiguidou in the aid department captured in projects #66174, #70502, and #66175. As of September 2015, according to a Chinese foreign ministry article, plans to construct an agricultural demonstration center are still in formation. leads.title: 'Agricultural Cooperation Plan' for bilateral agricultural cooperation initiatives between Chinese and Cuban governments (linked to #54856, #69983)
leads.description: On 5 July, 2012, the Governments of Cuba and China signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) for agricultural cooperation during a meeting between Presidents Raúl Castro of Cuba and Hu Jintao of China.  This agreement is formally known as the 'Agricultural Cooperation Plan' (Plan de Cooperación Agrícola), and it lasted from 2012-2016.  The known sub-projects are: 1) Developing a core zone under Los Naranjos Genetics Company in Artemisa Province of Cuba to conduct cooperation in demonstration on different food processing and production (captured in linked project #54856); 2) Establishing the Moringa Science and Technology Cooperation Center at the Tropical Crop Research Institute of Yunnan in China and the Institute of Pasture and Forage of the Ministry of Agriculture of Cuba (captured in linked project #69983); 3) Setting up the Sericulture S&T Cooperation Center at the Sericultural Research Institute of the Chinese Academy of Agricultural Sciences (SRICAAS) and the National Sericulture Project Team of Cuba to develop cooperation in mulberry cultivation, silkworm rearing and product development; and 4) Conducting high yield demonstration for rice, kidney beans, and corn. leads.title: China conducts Phase III of Juncao Project in Lesotho (Linked to #21745, #55680, #55682)
leads.description: According to the China National Research Center of Juncao Technology, in March 2012, the Center submitted plans to the Chinese Ministry of Commerce for phase III of the Juncao Technical Demonstration Cooperation Project (援莱索托菌草技术合作项目第三期). On 3 July 2012 and 21 Aug 2012, the Chinese Ambassador and Basotho Minister of Development Planning signed an exchange of letters in which China pledged to send a team of 4 Chinese experts from Fujian Agriculture and Forestry University (FAFU) to carry out this project from May 2013 to May 2015. China also carried out phase I (#21745), phase II (#55681), phase IV (#55682). _x000D_ _x000D_ "Jun" (菌) means fungus and "cao" (草) means grass. Juncao, invented in 1986 by a Chinese scientist, refers to the practice of using herb plants to cultivate edible fungi. Since the project's initial signing in October 2006, Chinese experts from FAFU have been developing the Zhonglai Juncao Technology Demonstration Base in Maseru and training local Basotho the agricultural techniques to grow and the entrepreneurial skills to sell. _x000D_ _x000D_ Lesotho's agricultural industry cannot adequately feed the population yet small-scale farming is common. leads.title: China sends 24 experts to support implementation of Liberia's National Program for Food Security (Linked to #35267, Umbrella #87769)
leads.description: In November 2011, Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO) co-signed two new tripartite agreements with China, Liberia and Senegal respectively to support implementation of a series of food security initiatives and projects in Liberia and Senegal. The funding provided through the new agreement comes from the China Ministry of Agriculture through the FAO-China Trust Fund (see Umbrella Project #87769).  Under the agreement with Liberia, China contributed over $1 million USD (#35267) and provided technical assistance through 24 Chinese experts and technicians to support Liberia's National Program for Food Security over a two-year period. The Chinese South-South Cooperation (SSC) team arrived at Liberia in May 2012 and left in April 2014.   The Chinese team cooperated with the Liberian Ministry of Agriculture in rice production, animal husbandry, aquaculture, vegetable production, plant protection, farm machinery, water conservancy and so on.
